title: Compact-open injectivity for directed colimit sections
statement: Compact-open injectivity for directed colimit sections.

proof.text: Stalks preserve the sheaf colimit by [lem-weil-pbc-sets-sheaf-colimit-stalks]. Apply this functor to the given equality of section images. Equality in the filtered colimit of stalks gives a common stage by [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-sets-elementwise]. Mathlib Presheaf.germ_eq then gives an open neighborhood, contained in U, on which the two sections at that stage agree. This is the private lemma colimit_sections_locally_eventually_equal.

Choose such a neighborhood and stage for each point of U. IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover gives finitely many neighborhoods covering U. Their stage indices together with the two initial indices form a finite set; Set.Finite.bddAbove gives an upper bound, also when the cover is empty. Naturality and the functor composition law transport all local equalities to this bound. Sheaf separation (Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq') gives equality on U. This is colimit_sections_eventually_equal.

Represent each of two elements of the section colimit by a section using Types.jointly_surjective. The canonical-map equations turn equality of their images into equality of the sheaf-colimit images. The preceding eventual equality and Types.FilteredColimit.colimit_eq_iff give equality in the section colimit, hence injectivity.
